text.description_html:
Acorn RUIBI, Heart Tip Gate Rim Latch

The Heart Tip Thick Gate Rim Latch comes packaged as a complete set with everything you'll need to install it on a gate that is up to 4 inches thick. The Heart Tip Gate Rim Latch made from iron so that it will be sure to add an authentic old world touch to any lightweight door. Made by Acorn, it has a rough black iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of natural weathered iron.

Specifications: of the Heart Tip Forged Iron Rim Latch Set:

  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reservable.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Features of Gate Rim Latch Set:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Handle Height: 10-1/2"
  • Handle Width: 2-3/4"
  • Latch Bar: 2" x 1/4"
  • Door Thickness: for gates up to 4" thick

Sold as a set.
